[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-26.1.2-blue.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mods)
[![Loader](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loader-Fabric-lightgrey.svg)](https://fabricmc.net/)


The **byDennyy Client** is the exclusive companion mod for the **byDennyy.de** network. This mod enhances your gaming experience with a seamlessly integrated, secure cosmetic system and a modern in-game shop.

---

## DISCLAIMER: External Server Connectivity
This mod automatically contacts the byDennyy.de backend server when you join a byDennyy.de network server. It does so to:

Load and verify your cosmetics
Verify your identity using the official Mojang session API (joinServer / hasJoined)
Your Minecraft access token is never sent to byDennyy servers. Identity is verified exclusively via Mojang's own session verification endpoint. The mod only transmits your player UUID, username, and a one-time session nonce to byDennyy.de.

This mod does not function on servers outside the byDennyy.de network.

## Features

### Seamless In-Game Web Shop
* Open the shop at any time in-game with the press of a button.
* Purchase and manage cosmetics directly through the in-game interface.

### Security & Privacy
* **BDC Encryption:** All cosmetic files are loaded in encrypted form (`.bdc` format) and securely decrypted to prevent unauthorized downloads and asset scraping.
* **Mojang Session Integration:** Secure communication with the web servers via your official Minecraft session.

### HUD Wallet Display
* Displays your current Coins and Gems directly on the HUD when you are on the network.

---

## Installation & Requirements

1. Install the **Fabric Loader** for Minecraft 26.1.2
2. Download this mod and place the `.jar` file in your `mods` folder.
3. **Required dependencies:**
   - [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
   - [GeckoLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib) (for advanced cosmetic models)

---

* The use and rendering of cosmetics are exclusively tied to the official **byDennyy.de** networks
